related_questions.snippet: The prevalence of clinical dental anxiety ranges from about 4% to over 20% worldwide, with 48% of adults estimated to experience dental anxiety in the UK [8,12]. related_questions.snippet: People with this specific phobia feel anxious when they think about going to the dentist or actually visit the dentist.
